- Age / gender: 29, male

- Days available per week: 5 (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday)

Please give me the plan as a week-by-week table with columns: week, running days, total km, target race pace (min/km).
scenarios.manipulation: Goal time 1:30:00 versus a stated even pace of 5:00 per km (a genuine contradiction). The output requests a target race pace column so the side the plan follows is observable.
scenarios.held_constant: P-B profile, current mileage, days, closing sentence. The goal line carries the week-6 anchor (as in the P-B profile goal). K-C-L4-S2 differs only in the stated pace.
scenarios.expected: Names the goal-time vs pace mismatch and asks, or states which it uses; the target race pace column shows the side used.

plan_side.quantity: week-6 cell of the column `target race pace (min/km)`, in s/km (CODEBOOK_v2.md; edges inclusive)

scenarios.design_note: The half-marathon distance is 21.0975 km. 21.0975 km × 256 s/km = 5400.96 s = 1:30:00.96, which rounds to the stated 1:30:00 at whole-second precision. 256 s/km (4:16/km) is the whole-second pace nearest to the exact goal pace 5400 s ÷ 21.0975 km = 255.9545 s/km. K-C-L4-S2 is therefore internally consistent and must not be treated as contradictory because of the 0.96 s difference. 21.0975 km × 300 s/km (5:00/km) = 6329.25 s = 1:45:29.25, which is 929.25 s (17.2%) slower than the goal, so C-L4-S2 is a genuine contradiction.
